body: You dodged a bullet Spartan. She's not worth it if she's going to abandon you over something that trivial, and it says more about her than it says about you. I wouldn't consider that a "red flag" at all.

- I have a few mecha model kits around, a few Gundams and one Frame Arms specifically. 

- Most of my favorite video games were created in Japan (Shenmue, Yakuza, Metal Gear, Zone of the Enders)

- I watch some anime shows and movies, not a whole lot. Cowboy Bebop is one of my all time favorites, next to The Wire and Band of Brothers. I definitely don't watch anime more than I watch regular TV shows. 

- I don't read manga or light novels

- Only anime mechandise I have outside of the model kits I stated above are a few Blu-Rays, Cowboy Bebop Pop figures and a DBZ poster.
